parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem: Siddharth's classmate catches measles. The school nurse says measles is caused by a virus and spreads from person to person through coughs and close contact. The class sorts diseases as communicable, non-communicable, or chronic.

part_answers.answer: Measles is caused by a pathogen and spreads from person to person, so it is communicable.

teacher.key_rationale: A virus that spreads person to person makes measles communicable, not non-communicable or chronic-only.
